verified_facts.text: The resort is rooted in the history of the Aspen Institute and was designed by Herbert Bayer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooted in the history of the Aspen Institute and designed by Herbert Bayer

verified_facts.text: The resort grounds cover 40 acres of rolling meadows and groves.
verified_facts.excerpt: As you wander through our 40 acres of rolling meadows and beautiful groves

verified_facts.text: The resort is within walking distance of Aspen's outdoor pursuits, skiing, shopping and restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aspen Meadows is within walking distance of Aspen’s year-round outdoor pursuits, skiing, shopping, and restaurants

verified_facts.text: The entire 40-acre property was designed by Herbert Bayer between 1953 and 1973 and is considered a Bauhaus-inspired total work of art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our entire 40-acre property, designed by Herbert Bayer between 1953 and 1973, is considered a Bauhaus-inspired “total work of art.”

verified_facts.text: Bayer wove outdoor walkways through a sculpted landscape of mounds, ponds and paths known as his earthworks.
verified_facts.excerpt: weaving outdoor walkways through his sculpted landscape (mounds, ponds, and paths collectively known as his "earthworks")

verified_facts.text: The campus includes three art galleries and many Bayer-designed outdoor sculptures, including Anaconda, Marble Garden and Kaleidoscreen, along with the earthworks of Anderson Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The campus includes three art galleries and many Bayer-designed outdoor sculptures, including Anaconda, 1978, Marble Garden, 1955, and Kaliedoscreen, 1957 along with the iconic earthworks of Anderson Park

verified_facts.text: A self-guided tour of the campus sculpture and land art is available on the Bloomberg Connects app, using QR codes next to each artwork.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the stories behind the sculpture and land art throughout the Aspen Meadows campus with a new self-guided tour on the Bloomberg Connects app. Just scan the QR codes located next to each artwork

verified_facts.text: Visitors can sign up for complimentary guided walking tours led by landscape architect Ann Mullins.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visitors can also sign up for complimentary guided walking tours led by landscape architect Ann Mullins.

verified_facts.text: The Resnick Center for Herbert Bayer Studies, an art museum on the Aspen Institute campus, is free and open to the public.
verified_facts.excerpt: Resnick Center for Herbert Bayer Studies (Art Museum) is free and open to the public.

verified_facts.text: Bayer's Grass Mound, completed in 1955, is one of the first earthworks ever made, predating the land art movement by nearly ten years.
verified_facts.excerpt: Herbert Bayer’s Grass Mound was completed in 1955. Notably, this is one of the first earthworks ever made, predating the land art movement by nearly ten years.

verified_facts.text: Buckminster Fuller's geodesic dome, designed for the 1952 International Design Conference, stands on the campus and was later used as a cover for the Aspen Meadows pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Buckminster Fuller’s 36-foot-diameter dome was designed for the 1952 International Design Conference and was later used as a cover for the Aspen Meadows pool.

verified_facts.text: Andy Goldsworthy's Stone River, a sandstone serpentine wall, winds into and through the Doerr-Hosier Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: renowned artist Andy Goldsworthy’s sandstone serpentine wall winds into and through the Doerr-Hosier Center

verified_facts.text: All accommodations are suites inspired by the resort's Bauhaus roots.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our accommodations are spacious, newly reimagined suites, inspired by our Bauhaus roots to invite a deeper connection with nature.

verified_facts.text: The guest suites feature floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: guest suites feature floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary furnishings

verified_facts.text: Every suite has living, working and sleeping areas to suit everyone from business travelers to families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every suite is thoughtfully designed with living, working, and sleeping areas to accommodate everyone from business travelers to families.

verified_facts.text: Suites include Ferenc Berko photographs and a drop station for catching gear and jackets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms include a "drop station" for catching gear and jackets, and Ferenc Berko photographs.

verified_facts.text: The guest suites are located in six separate buildings.
verified_facts.excerpt: The guest suites at the Aspen Meadows Resort are located in six separate buildings.

verified_facts.text: The Health Center has TRX, cardio and weight equipment, a Peloton bike, steam rooms, an outdoor heated saline lap pool, a hot tub and a half-court indoor gymnasium with basketball.
verified_facts.excerpt: has TRX, cardio and weight equipment, a Peloton bike, steam rooms, an outdoor heated saline lap pool, a hot tub, as well as a half court indoor gymnasium with basketball.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor heated lap pool is available by reservation, and the outdoor hot tub is first-come, first-served.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our outdoor heated lap pool is available by reservation. The outdoor hot tub is available on a first-come, first-served basis

verified_facts.text: A Nootka barrel sauna overlooks Aspen's mountain vistas.
verified_facts.excerpt: step inside a relaxing Nootka barrel sauna retreat and embrace mindful moments amid Aspen's beautiful mountain vistas

verified_facts.text: The Racquet Sports Center, run in partnership with Brisas, has a padel court, petanque court, backgammon tables, clothing shack and lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring a padel court, pétanque court, backgammon tables, clothing shack and lounge

verified_facts.text: Tennis and pickleball courts have a backdrop of Aspen Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Play on one of our tennis or pickleball courts with the stunning backdrop of Aspen Mountain

verified_facts.text: Complimentary e-bike rentals are available to hotel guests in summer and fall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary e-bike rentals available in Summer and Fall months to hotel guests

verified_facts.text: Complimentary snowshoe rentals are offered in winter, picked up at the Health Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer complimentary snowshoe rentals during the winter season. Please enjoy them for 4 hours at a time. Available for pick-up at the Health Center.

verified_facts.text: Guests have a complimentary ski shuttle to Buttermilk.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests enjoy our complimentary ski shuttle to Buttermilk.

verified_facts.text: The resort partners with Ski Butlers, which delivers ski rentals to all four mountains or directly to the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ski Butlers deliver to all four mountains, or directly to Aspen Meadows Resort.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary on-site parking and a shuttle to and from Aspen/Pitkin County Airport are offered.
verified_facts.excerpt: Arrive with ease at Aspen Meadows Resort with complimentary on-site parking or a convenient shuttle service to and from Aspen/Pitkin County Airport.

verified_facts.text: Electric shuttle buses run to downtown Aspen.
verified_facts.excerpt: take advantage of our eco-friendly electric shuttle buses, running every half hour from 7:00 AM to 10:30 PM, to downtown Aspen

verified_facts.text: West End Social restaurant has 270-degree views of Aspen's mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our newly reimagined restaurant features 270-degree views of Aspen’s mountains and an approachable menu designed for every occasion

verified_facts.text: Meadows Cafe serves La Colombe coffee alongside pastries by Executive Pastry Chef Sara Figueiredo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight in La Colombe coffee, lattes and cold brew to complement the creative pastries and breakfast items crafted by our Executive Pastry Chef, Sara Figueiredo.

verified_facts.text: The resort has no elevators.
verified_facts.excerpt: No elevators

verified_facts.text: A private patio or balcony is available in most guest suites, not all.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private patio or balcony—available in most guest suites

verified_facts.text: Families can borrow a Polaroid camera from the front desk for nature, wildlife and art scavenger hunts across the 40-acre campus.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rent a Polaroid camera from the front desk and gather your family for a fall adventure across our 40-acre campus.
